subject: Harmony Health API outage — compensation proposal and next steps
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@harmonyhealth.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: support@harmonyhealth.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: sudden errors - Harmony Health production API (Mar 21)

Karthik —

We saw a widespread spike in 500s across our production inference calls starting ~05:20 PDT and lasting roughly 90 minutes. The errors caused several customer-facing failures (billing, scheduling) and about 18% request loss during the window. Our engineering team collected traces and the attached log snippet — forwarding to your support alias too.

This impacted a handful of paying customers; procurement is already asking what goodwill/remedy will look like. Can you confirm root cause ETA and what compensation Redwood will provide? We need something we can show leadership by EOD PST.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform
Harmony Health

Attachment: harmony-impacted-usage.csv (CSV — per-minute error rates + request ids)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@harmonyhealth.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: sudden errors - Harmony Health production API (Mar 21)

Elena, thank you for the heads-up and for the logs — I’m sorry for the disruption. I’ve pulled the incident into our internal channel and looped in Monica (CS) and Jordan (account lead) so we can coordinate a remedy.

High-level next steps:
- Monica will share an internal timeline + impacted usage and a proposed compensation package (token/top-up, credits, trial extension).
- I’ll get an ops summary and RCA ETA from the on-call infra lead; we should have an initial root-cause note within 24 hours.
- Jordan — can you confirm whether Harmony prefers a credits percentage-style remediation on the March invoice or a token top-up + trial extension?

We’ll treat this as a priority.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Customer Success 
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@harmonyhealth.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: sudden errors - Harmony Health production API (Mar 21) — proposed remedy

Elena / team —

Thanks for the context and the CSV, Elena. I pulled usage and validated the ~05:20–06:50 PDT window. Here’s our recommended remediation to make Harmony whole while we complete the RCA and follow-up:

Proposal (recommended):
- Immediate token top-up of 100,000 inference tokens to Harmony’s account (visible instantly).
- 45-day trial/credits extension on your current pilot tier (no change to entitlements).
- One-time invoice credit of 25% on the portion of usage attributable to the impacted window, capped at $15k.

Why this mix: token top-up provides immediate runway for customer-facing retries and demos; the trial extension helps procurement with pipeline timelines; the invoice credit is our formal bill-side remedy tied to measurable impacted usage.

I’ve attached the draft comp spreadsheet that includes impacted usage, calculation, and proposed ledger entries. If you prefer a single approach (e.g., only invoice credit), we can pivot — Jordan, please flag any commercial constraints.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: comp-proposal.xlsx (spreadsheet — impacted usage, proposed credits)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@harmonyhealth.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: sudden errors - Harmony Health production API (Mar 21) — commercial check

Monica / Karthik / Elena —

Thanks Monica, proposal looks reasonable as a customer-first offer. A couple of commercial checks from my side before final sign-off:
- We need approval for the $15k credit cap from finance for this account (Harmony is still in pilot).
- If we do the token top-up, confirm whether tokens expire or are evergreen for Harmony’s contract — legal will want that clear.

Elena — from a procurement perspective, would a token top-up + 45-day extension be acceptable to close this quickly? If procurement needs a formal invoice adjustment instead, flag that now so we can route to finance/legal.

I’ll ping Markus for quick approval on the $15k cap and confirm token expiry rules.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: sudden errors - Harmony Health production API (Mar 21) — approval

All,

I reviewed the proposed package. Given Harmony’s pilot status and the visibility this incident will have with their procurement/leadership, I approve the customer-facing offer with a small tweak:

Approved offer (final):
- 100,000 inference token top-up (non-expiring for 12 months; will be marked in ledger as incident remediation).
- 45-day trial/credit extension.
- One-time invoice credit equivalent to 20% of impacted-window usage, capped at $12,500.

Notes:
- Reduce the dollar cap slightly to $12.5k to preserve precedent.
- Token top-up will be redeemable via account balance (operations to apply).
- Monica: please coordinate a short acceptance statement from Harmony (email OK) that we can keep for the comp ledger and compliance audit.

Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@harmonyhealth.ai>, procurement@harmonyhealth.ai
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Mar 2028 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: sudden errors - Harmony Health production API (Mar 21) — final remedy and acceptance request

Elena / Harmony procurement —

Following our internal review, Redwood will provide the remediation below for the March 21 incident (05:20–06:50 PDT). Please reply to confirm acceptance so we can process the ledger entries and apply the token top-up immediately.

Final remediation (per approval):
- 100,000 inference tokens added to Harmony account (marked as incident remediation; usable against inference calls; documented in your account billing page).
- 45-day extension to your current trial/credit window.
- One-time invoice credit equal to 20% of the calculated impacted-window usage, capped at $12,500.

Action items:
1) Reply to this email with a short acceptance line ("Harmony accepts the remediation above; please apply." is fine).
2) If procurement needs an invoice adjustment request or PO to apply the credit, attach that in reply and CC finance@harmonyhealth.ai.

Links: HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/98765
Compliance folder (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDefGhiJKlmnopq

We’ll aim to have the token top-up visible within 2 business hours of acceptance and ledger entries posted within 3 business days. Monica will follow up on the ledger documentation for your records.

Thanks again for the patience — we’ll share the RCA once the post-mortem is complete.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
